note: The declared half of each species' spatial strategy: its evidence family and what North Ground is building toward. What it HOLDS — surfaces, survey plots, zone evidence — is never declared here; `src/lib/hunt/intelligence/spatial-strategy.ts` derives it from the certified registries, so this file cannot make a species look covered. Every published species must have an entry; the test reads the catalogue.
